name: DEPwD Top Class Education Scholarship for Students with Benchmark Disabilities
provider: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must have a benchmark disability of at least 40% under the RPwD Act 2016, with a valid disability certificate and UDID card or enrolment number
Indian nationals only; Aadhaar-based authentication is required
Not more than two children with disabilities of the same parents may receive benefits
Cannot receive another scholarship or stipend at the same time
Must study a graduate or postgraduate degree or diploma at an institution notified by DEPwD (premier institutions list)
Distance-learning, part-time and weekend courses are not eligible
Can be awarded only once to an individual
benefit: Tuition and admission fee reimbursement up to Rs 1,90,000/year, miscellaneous fees up to Rs 10,000/year, one-time Rs 45,000 for computer or laptop and Rs 30,000 for aids and assistive devices in the first year, maintenance allowance Rs 3,000/month (hosteller) or Rs 1,500/month (day scholar), special allowance Rs 2,000/month, book allowance Rs 5,000/year. About 300 slots a year, 50% reserved for girls.
documents: Valid disability certificate issued by the competent authority
UDID card or UDID enrolment number
